How The Walt Disney Company connects

  • Event: Disney acquisition — Disney bought Pixar in 2006.
  • Topic: Pixar — Disney has been Pixar's parent company since 2006.

What is The Walt Disney Company?

The Walt Disney Company bought Pixar in 2006, bringing Catmull and Lasseter into Disney Animation as well and folding Pixar into the larger studio family.
